review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in blast-rule.json. MEASURED: the fifteen ROCKET records of ZBD/zrdr.zbd weapons.zrd through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_rocket_blasts (IMPACT_PROXIMITY, DETONATION_DISTANCE, DETONATION_TIME, ARMOR_DAMAGE, HEALTH_DAMAGE, LOCK_ON and the full key set, pinned at 41 names with none of EXPIRES, MINE, DETONATE_AT_RANGE, HIT_OWNER, REMOTE_DETONATE, TETHER_GUIDED or MULTI_TARGET); and byte windows of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (sha-256 recorded) carrying the area falloff (1 - d^2/r^2 with r = IMPACT_PROXIMITY, MINE flat), the target-pointer clear that defines a lost target, the target-pointer test that skips the DETONATION_DISTANCE proximity branch, and the DETONATION_TIME timer fallback. The rule: the original has no lost-target Detonate behavior; a lost target skips the proximity trigger so the rocket detonates on its timer or at the end of RANGE, and every detonation damages every object inside IMPACT_PROXIMITY with armor and health damage scaled by 1 - d^2/r^2. cs_sim now models that blast (AreaEffect::blast_fraction, OrdnanceRuntime::route_detonation_area), tested in CI with synthetic geometry. FIDELITY LIMITATIONS (unmeasured, none claimed): see the limitations array of blast-rule.json - the unit scale of IMPACT_PROXIMITY (claim t548.limit.units, resolving task: follow-up filed with Rally), the projectile +0x678 multiplier (t548.limit.scale), the +0xbc object field and 0xa1d7d4 gate in the apply loop (t548.limit.recipient_gate), whether the area entry value is a squared distance (t548.limit.entry_value), what removes a projectile past RANGE (t548.limit.range_end), the effect of the SONIC, FLASH, BEEPER, TANGLER and SMOKE_SCREEN keys (t548.limit.status_keys) and the RANGE_MINIMUM node call (t548.limit.range_minimum). route_detonation_area is not yet called by step_ordnance_session (t548.limit.session_wiring). The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
